description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] or [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Celes (Ice/Holy)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Celes (Ice/Holy)
description.text: Increases [Ice/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ice or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Celes after using Ice or Holy abilities (max 5), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Celes
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 2] and [Quick Cast 2] to all allies

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
